selection: Admit the minimal row-reduction change. It has the lowest saved matched median; retain the final-dot alternative as evidence without interpreting its small difference as a separate speed claim.

retained.verbatim_saved_policy: Nonblank, noncomment physical LOC plus separately audited packed statements, inline/chained assignments and imperative function headers; no compressed-size metric. Structural separators are unchanged. Runtime/library bindings are pinned and shown separately; all benchmark algorithms remain in the listed source.
retained.closers: No standalone closer rows occur. Braces/parentheses on a source row do not create extra units; any written significant closer-only row would retain the historical physical unit.
retained.packed_statements: Exactly the same line4 Av+2 and line5 Atv+2 explicit expansion as the pinned parent; native Sum is a call replacing a reduction, not a new source binding or helper.
retained.pure_array_expressions: Pure coefficient and composed AtAv function bindings, nested pure Each row callbacks, reductions, array arithmetic, repetition, and output formatting remain expression owners; primitive/internal loops are not scalarized.
retained.limit: Manual exact-source retained-policy replay; not a whole-language grammar or native parser certificate. No proposed-v2 rule is used.

source_delta.method: replace only the two literal row-reduction tokens {+´v× by {•math.Sum v×

support_boundary.application: All nine significant source rows, including argv parsing, coefficient, all four functions, vector initialization, all twenty AtAv applications, final products and formatting, are counted.
support_boundary.excluded_support: No imports, user-provided support or FFI helper. Ordinary pinned CBQN math.Sum implementation is vendor runtime and is not added to application LOC.

line_ledger.source_text: # Four separately defined functions, with coefficients evaluated in every multiply.

independent_review.normalization: Identical parent owner shapes: nine significant physical rows plus two additional owners for each of Av and Atv. Only two reduction primitives change.
